title: Sources: EA is marketing a $15B debt package to fund its $55B Saudi-led take-private deal, including nearly $700M in projected annual cost savings (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: EA is marketing a $15B debt package to fund its $55B Saudi-led take-private deal, including nearly $700M in projected annual cost savings — For Electronic Arts Inc.'s prospective debt investors, Battlefield 6 and Skate aren't just two of the video-game maker's most popular titles.
